name: Multivariable Calculus: Nablix
subtitle: Multivariable calculus 3
shortDescription: Adaptive multivariable calculus (calculus 3): 3D labs, quizzes and worked solutions, from partial derivatives to Stokes. Free to use.
longDescription:
Multivariable Calculus: Nablix is a calculus 3 study app that follows your mistakes. Work through vectors and surfaces, partial derivatives and gradients, optimisation with Lagrange multipliers, double, triple, polar, cylindrical and spherical integrals, vector fields, line and surface integrals, and the theorems of Green, Stokes and divergence.

### How It Adapts
A short placement check finds your starting point. Each practice session then picks the next question from what you got wrong: a repeated sign slip brings back sign-sensitive problems, a skipped chain-rule term brings back chain-rule problems, and topics you have not touched for a while return for review. Prefer the usual syllabus order? Switch to the course-order path at any time.

### Six Simulations To Drag
- Quadric Slicer: seven quadric surfaces and a plane you slide through them; the cut curve is named live (ellipse, hyperbola, parabola, crossing lines) and its area is shown.
- Surface Frame Lab: ride a point over a sphere, torus, cone, helicoid or paraboloid and see the tangent vectors, the normal and the matrix they fill, beside a chart of the parameter rectangle.
- Direction Fan: spin a direction around a point and watch the slope trace the gradient's cosine.
- Operator Triptych: measure gradient, divergence and curl on one small circle with flux arrows and a paddle wheel.
- Volume Element Builder: build r dz dr dθ and ρ² sin φ dρ dφ dθ from visible cells and compare the sums with and without the factor.
- Two-Sided Theorems: Green's and Stokes' theorems with both sides as live numbers, and a cap you can reshape without changing the answer.
Every number in a simulation is computed by the app and checked against a second method; each simulation has a Sources button that lists the exact textbook sections and opens linked pages inside the app. Four earlier labs (surface, contour and descent, field, region slicer) stay as well.

### Practice And Checkpoints
More than 250 original problems, each with a full worked solution, the reason every wrong choice fails and the common mistake. Unit checkpoints, placement, and a timed mock exam with no ads. Every stored answer is recomputed by independent code before release.

### Refreshers And Next Steps
Tap any concept for a school-level refresher, a short version for this course, and a pointer to where it leads. Pages list what to study before and after this course. University courses, textbooks and videos are cited and open in a clear source window with their licence and a link.

### Free To Use
Lessons, labs and every worked solution are free. Short ads appear only at natural breaks such as after a finished quiz, never during a timed test. You can also watch an optional video for credits toward mock exams.

### Ad-Free Monthly Subscription (Optional)
Multivariable Calculus Ad-Free removes ads. It starts with a 7-day free trial, then renews every month at the price shown by the App Store until you cancel. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. No account is needed and your progress stays on your device.

All teaching text, problems and simulations are original. For study only; not for engineering or safety decisions. Not affiliated with any university, publisher or exam body.
